200.description: Server-Sent Events. Each `data:` line is one StreamEvent (the `event` field is sent as the SSE event name).

schema.title: Response Source Chunks Sources  Source Id  Chunks Get

200.description: Server-Sent Events, one `stage` event per step until `done` or `error`. Follow it with the id sent as `?job=` on the upload.

Cell.description:
One stored value as the answer shows it. `text` is None when the invoice has no such value.

`cite` is the position in `citations` of the citation that carries the same stored value.
Cell.title: Cell

Clarification.description:
The question is ambiguous: the user picks one of the real candidates.

`question` of the chosen candidate is the original question with that invoice named.
`total` counts every matching invoice; `candidates` holds at most the first five.
Clarification.title: Clarification

ClarificationCandidate.description: An invoice the question may refer to. Every field comes from the stored invoice.
ClarificationCandidate.title: ClarificationCandidate

FollowUp.description: A question the service can answer from what it found: a field of the same invoice, or a nearby section.
FollowUp.title: FollowUp

KeyDataBlock.description: The data of one invoice, each with its citation.
KeyDataBlock.title: KeyDataBlock

PageHighlight.title: PageHighlight
PageHighlight.description: Where a cited quote sits on a page. `reason` says why there are no rectangles.

Rect.title: Rect
Rect.description: A rectangle as fractions of the page, origin at the top left.

Segment.description:
A piece of the answer and the citations that support it.

`refs` are positions in `citations`. The `text` of all segments concatenates to the answer.
Segment.title: Segment

Suggestion.description: A real, nearby source shown when the question cannot be answered.
Suggestion.title: Suggestion

TableBlock.description: Invoices as rows. The first column is the invoice number.
TableBlock.title: TableBlock

TableRow.description: `cells` follow `columns`. `question` asks for the data of this row's invoice.
TableRow.title: TableRow

TableSummary.description: Calculated total, with the citation positions of every operand.
TableSummary.title: TableSummary

IngestStageEvent.description: One step of an upload being processed (`event: stage`).
IngestStageEvent.title: IngestStageEvent
